items.title: Chelsea's Lavia out to 'change narrative' after injuries
items.summary: Chelsea midfielder Romeo Lavia says he is finally reaping the rewards of his hard work and is determined to "change the narrative" around him.
items.whyItMatters: Football creates regular global sports momentum and quick-return storylines.

items.title: Mbappé and Vinícius caught in Spain's migration debate after obscuring message on Ceuta shirts
items.summary: While Mbappé, Vinícius and teammate Ibrahima Konaté put on the shirts, they wore them rolled up to their chests so that some of the words were obscured.

items.title: Kostyuk into Guadalajara last eight without playing a point
items.summary: Marta Kostyuk is through to the quarter-finals of the Guadalajara Open even though the top seed is yet to play a point in the tournament.
